This notebook explores the relationship between reference-scenario inundation
coverage (`raw_coverage_pct_ref`, the percentage of a water supply's 4 km
buffer already inundated at current sea level) and distance to the nearest
NOAA CUSP shoreline (`shore_dist_m`). The goal is to understand whether coastal
proximity predicts existing inundation extent.

# Establish environment

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
source("setup.R")
mapviewOptions(fgb = FALSE)
```

# Load data

## Water supplies

```{r, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
water_supplies <- get_wsd(rapid = TRUE)
```

## Inundation exposure results

```{r}
inun_files <- list.files(
  here("data", "rapid", "outputs"),
  pattern    = "^inundation_exposure_.*\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

inundation_exp <- read_csv(inun_files[length(inun_files)], show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Coastal weights (distance to shore)

```{r}
coastal_weights <- read_csv(
  here("data", "rapid", "inputs", "coast_comp", "coastal_weights.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

# Join and filter

Filter to 4 km buffer and join distance-to-coast onto inundation results. Water
supplies more than 50 km from the coast have `shore_dist_m = NA`.

```{r}
inun_4km <- inundation_exp %>%
  filter(buffer_km == 4)

ws_joined <- water_supplies %>%
  inner_join(
    inun_4km %>% select(-park_unit),
    by = "wsd_source_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    coastal_weights %>% select(wsd_source_id, shore_dist_m, coastal_weight),
    by = "wsd_source_id"
  )
```

# Maps

## Reference inundation coverage

Higher values (dark blue) indicate a greater proportion of the 4 km buffer is
already inundated at current sea level. Grey points have no inundation data
(inland water supplies outside the NOAA SLR domain).

```{r}
pal_blue <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "steelblue", "darkblue"))

ws_inun <- ws_joined %>% filter(!is.na(raw_coverage_pct_ref))
ws_no_inun <- ws_joined %>% filter(is.na(raw_coverage_pct_ref))

m_inun <- mapview(ws_inun,
                  zcol        = "raw_coverage_pct_ref",
                  col.regions = pal_blue,
                  layer.name  = "Ref inundation coverage (%)",
                  popup       = leafpop::popupTable(
                    sf::st_drop_geometry(ws_inun) %>%
                      select(wsd_source_id, park_name, water_system_name,
                             raw_coverage_pct_ref, raw_coverage_pct_proj,
                             shore_dist_m, inun_change)
                  ))

if (nrow(ws_no_inun) > 0) {
  m_inun <- m_inun +
    mapview(ws_no_inun,
            col.regions = "grey70",
            color       = "grey70",
            layer.name  = "No inundation data",
            popup       = leafpop::popupTable(
              sf::st_drop_geometry(ws_no_inun) %>%
                select(wsd_source_id, park_name, water_system_name, shore_dist_m)
            ))
}

m_inun
```

## Distance to coast

Red = close to the coast, green = near the 50 km boundary, grey = more than
50 km from coast (no `shore_dist_m` value assigned).

```{r}
pal_dist <- colorRampPalette(c("red", "yellow", "green"))

ws_coastal <- ws_joined %>% filter(!is.na(shore_dist_m))
ws_inland  <- ws_joined %>% filter(is.na(shore_dist_m))

m_dist <- mapview(ws_coastal,
                  zcol        = "shore_dist_m",
                  col.regions = pal_dist,
                  layer.name  = "Distance to coast (m)",
                  popup       = leafpop::popupTable(
                    sf::st_drop_geometry(ws_coastal) %>%
                      select(wsd_source_id, park_name, water_system_name,
                             shore_dist_m, coastal_weight,
                             raw_coverage_pct_ref, raw_coverage_pct_proj)
                  ))

if (nrow(ws_inland) > 0) {
  m_dist <- m_dist +
    mapview(ws_inland,
            col.regions = "grey70",
            color       = "grey70",
            layer.name  = ">50 km from coast",
            popup       = leafpop::popupTable(
              sf::st_drop_geometry(ws_inland) %>%
                select(wsd_source_id, park_name, water_system_name, raw_coverage_pct_ref)
            ))
}

m_dist
```

# Relationship: reference inundation vs. distance to coast

Scatter plot of reference inundation coverage vs. log distance to coast for
water supplies within 50 km of the coast. The y-axis is log-transformed to
spread out the many water supplies clustered near the shoreline. Points are
colored by `park_name`.

```{r}
ws_scatter <- ws_joined %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(!is.na(shore_dist_m), !is.na(raw_coverage_pct_ref))

r2 <- summary(lm(log(shore_dist_m) ~ raw_coverage_pct_ref, data = ws_scatter))$r.squared

p <- ggplot(ws_scatter,
            aes(x     = raw_coverage_pct_ref,
                y     = log(shore_dist_m),
                color = park_name,
                text  = paste0("ID: ", wsd_source_id,
                               "<br>System: ", water_system_name,
                               "<br>Park: ", park_name,
                               "<br>Dist to coast: ", round(shore_dist_m), " m",
                               "<br>Ref inundation: ", round(raw_coverage_pct_ref, 2), "%"))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linetype = "dashed",
              inherit.aes = FALSE,
              aes(x = raw_coverage_pct_ref, y = log(shore_dist_m))) +
  annotate("text",
           x     = max(ws_scatter$raw_coverage_pct_ref) * 0.95,
           y     = max(log(ws_scatter$shore_dist_m)) * 0.98,
           label = paste0("R² = ", round(r2, 3)),
           hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 4, color = "black") +
  labs(x     = "Reference inundation coverage (% of 4 km buffer)",
       y     = "Log distance to nearest shoreline (m)",
       color = "Park unit") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

plotly::ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
```
